_comment: Copy this file to config/accounts.json (gitignored) and add your real mailboxes. Big Dog pulls them all into one inbox. Works with any IMAP/SMTP provider: Gmail (use an App Password), Outlook/Microsoft 365, Fastmail, Yahoo, cPanel, custom domains, etc.
